about.title: From a small lawn maintenance business to sod installation
text: Mick's Grass & Sod Service was founded in 2008 as a small lawn maintenance business. Over time we grew into a sod installation contractor serving homeowners, builders, developers, general contractors and commercial clients.

Our history includes lawn maintenance, landscaping and sod production, and sod installation is now our central service. The scale of the work has changed, but the job has not: understand the project, prepare the site properly, coordinate the work and deliver a finished installation the client can depend on.
We treat each project as a complete installation scope, not sod as a stand-alone material. Customers who only need sod can buy it directly from Mick's Turf Farm, a separate business.
